summary: Day after the midterms: Democrats took both chambers, futures fell as much as 1.4% overnight and then reversed; at 07:42 ET SPY is +0.9% pre-market, QQQ +0.4%, IWM +1.4%, with the election rotation on top of the month's rotation: banks, health care, staples and small caps bid (XLF +1.5%, XLV +1.8%, XLP +1.5%), AI-capex and Musk-linked names sold (TSLA -5.8%, GEV -6.3%, ORCL -4.2% after cancelling its $7B Tencent deal under White House pressure, PLTR -3.8%). AMD gave back nearly all of its +8.6% after-hours pop (+0.9%) despite a beat and a $17B guide: the chip complex is flat to red (SMH -0.4%, MU -1.7%, INTC -2.6%, SNDK downgraded). ADP 08:15, trade 08:30, ISM services 10:00, ARM reports tonight. The night-down-then-pre-market-recovery lean (OVERNIGHT.md, 59% up) and the broad bid outside tech argue for a small up lean, the size of the gap and the lack of a mechanical edge on event days argue against trading it: p_up 0.54, none (08:31: ADP +86K vs 69K, SPY +0.9% but QQQ only +0.3%, SMH -1.3%, AMD flat after a +9.6% after-hours pop). No sniper: the names moving up have no news of their own (AMZN +3.6% with no headline found, MSFT +2.0%, LLY +2.0%), the names with fresh news are negatives (ORCL, TSLA, GEV) on a none day, and AMD/ANET/SMCI are report-window names.
reasons: Routine fired 07:41 ET; research 07:42-08:00; live numbers re-read after 08:30 (ADP 08:15, trade 08:30) before the call. news.yml dispatched 07:43; trade.yml to be dispatched at 08:30 (the bot exits when started earlier; the 08:45 cron is unreliable).

Election: CNN called the Senate for Democrats 23:35 ET (at least 51 seats; Ohio and Kansas flipped), NBC projects the House too (Jeffries as speaker). Futures fell as much as 1.4% on the night (ES low about 743.9 on SPY, QQQ low 668.96 = -2.4%) on AI-regulation and tax talk, then reversed: by 07:42 SPY 761.18 (+0.9% vs 754.35), QQQ 687.97 (+0.4%), IWM 283.74 (+1.4%). Reports: 10Y 4.92% (-3 bp from 4.95%), dollar at a five-week low (UUP -0.6%), gold +2%, WTI about 95.8 / Brent 102.8 (USO -1.6%), VIXY -4.4% (VIX about 17 by proxy).

Webull extended hours 07:42 ET (vs 11-03 close): SPY +0.9%, QQQ +0.4%, IWM +1.4%, XLF +1.5%, XLV +1.8%, XLP +1.5%, XLY +0.6%, XLE 0.0%, SMH -0.4%, TLT +0.4%, UUP -0.6%, USO -1.6%, VIXY -4.4%. Mega caps: AMZN +3.6%, MSFT +2.0%, LLY +2.0%, AAPL +1.5%, JPM +1.3%, META +1.0%, GOOGL +0.9%, AMD +0.9%, NVDA +0.1%, AVGO -0.2%, MU -1.7%, UNH -1.8%, MRVL -1.9%, INTC -2.6%, PLTR -3.8%, ORCL -4.2%, TSLA -5.8%, GEV -6.3%; ANET +7.5% and SMCI +3.4% on their reports.

AMD (reaction day, excluded today): Q3 revenue $13.38B vs $13.09B, EPS $2.09 vs $1.95, Q4 guide about $17B vs $16.2B, 2027 revenue growth 'more than 80%', but PC units to fall double digits in 2027; after hours it went 483.9 -> 530 (+9.6%) and is 488.3 (+0.9%) at 07:42 after Mizuho and B of A trimmed targets (610, 650) and Stifel raised (725). The dossier says the up gap on AMD continues 64% of the time but buying calls at 09:45 lost (-40%/trade, too much priced); the PC comment is a negative read-through for INTC (-2.6%) and memory (MU -1.7%, SNDK -1.4%, downgraded to Equal-Weight by Fox Advisors).

ORCL -4.2% (120.9): FT 01:13 'Oracle cancels $7bn Tencent AI deal under Trump pressure' (Benzinga 06:31/07:31): a fresh negative of its own on the day after a +5.8% squeeze; plus the election. Not a sniper: puts need a SPY put day, and the gap is over 4%. TSLA -5.8% (375.6) on the election (Musk's $366M GOP spending; Texas Senate and governor flipped, the governor-elect talks of a data-center moratorium) and a Korean FSD complaint; GEV -6.3% on the moratorium talk; PLTR -3.8% day two after its report. All three are puts on a none day: opportunities, not picks.

AMZN +3.6% (259.7) with no headline found (Benzinga feed, Webull search, two web searches): the Anthropic IPO (expected the week of 11-16, Amazon's notes marked at $146B) and Josh Brown's 'final trade' are the only threads. A mega cap +2% with no visible headline is a question: searched and still unexplained, so it is not a sniper (no catalyst of its own, gap over 3%, median target $330 leaves room but that is not news). MSFT +2.0% and LLY +2.0% likewise have no own news this morning (LLY's targets were raised 10-30; DZ Bank downgraded AAPL and XOM to Sell, downgrades do not carry per ANALYST.md).

Rating changes on mega caps this morning: none positive. DZ Bank cut AAPL and XOM to Sell; Fox Advisors cut SNDK; AMD targets mixed; B of A raised SMCI's target while keeping Underperform. Barclays upgraded BE to Overweight ($289) and JPM upgraded NET: outside the sniper universe (no same-day options, not mega caps), BE noted as an opportunity type only if a pre-market price is visible later.

Oil: WTI about 95.8 (USO -1.6%) after the Iran-talks drop on 11-02 and a bounce on 11-03; XLE flat pre-market, XOM downgraded. Yields: 10Y 4.92% (-3 bp), 2Y not confirmed this morning (4.56% at the 11-03 close per the other Claude's file); TLT +0.4%. Dollar -0.6% (five-week low per press). Lower yields and a weaker dollar with an equity bid is the 'Democratic sweep = less fiscal expansion, more regulation of AI' read; whether it survives the cash open is the question.

Macro today: ADP 08:15 (consensus 69K vs 90K), trade balance 08:30, S&P services PMI 09:45, ISM services 10:00 (consensus 54.8 vs 54.9; prices paid 74.0 prior), Dallas Fed's Logan 19:00; no coupon auction; jobs report Friday. Not a configured release day for the bot's macro filter (config/macro_events.json has nothing for 11-04).

Rebound_scanner universe down gaps >= 2% at 07:42: TSLA -5.8%, GEV -6.3%, ORCL -4.2%, PLTR -3.8%, INTC -2.6%; leader_follow at 09:45 will likely take AMZN or ANET (ANET reported, so the bot refuses it). meta_follow2 can fire (Wednesday) if META is >= 2% from its open after 30 minutes. nvda_gapdown_put: no (NVDA flat). stock_open_drive (Mon/Wed): TSLA or NVDA >= +0.8% from the open at 10:00. spy_open_drive: SPY >= +0.5% above its open at 10:00.

Why none: the gap is the election, which is priced at the open; QQQ lags SPY by half a point and the AI complex is red while value is bid, so the index direction depends on which side has more weight in the first hour; the overnight pattern (night down >= 0.3%, pre-market up >= 0.2%) leans up 59% (32 days) but with an average of +0.66% that the +0.9% gap may already contain. A call needs 0.60; p_up 0.55. Dossiers: AMD reaction day, nothing to trade; META no own catalyst (debut euro bond sale is financing, the type that fades).

08:31 re-read (Webull extended hours) after ADP +86K vs 69K (prior 90K) and the trade deficit $105.0B vs $108B: SPY 761.02 (+0.88%), QQQ 687.15 (+0.27%, down from +0.4%), IWM +1.6%, XLF +1.7%, XLV +2.2%, XLP +2.1%, XLY +1.6%, XLE -0.4%, SMH -1.3% (from -0.4%), TLT flat (the 07:42 bid is gone after the stronger ADP), UUP -0.7%, USO -2.2%, VIXY -4.7%. Stocks: AMZN +3.7%, LLY +2.3%, MSFT +2.1%, AAPL +1.6%, JPM +1.5%, GOOGL +0.6%, META +0.3% (from +1.0%), AMD 0.0% (all of the after-hours gain gone), NVDA -1.2%, AVGO -1.1%, MU -2.5%, INTC -2.5%, MRVL -3.2%, UNH -1.8%, ORCL -3.8%, PLTR -4.6%, TSLA -4.6%, GEV -6.2%. The split sharpened: value, health care and small caps stronger, the whole AI complex weaker, QQQ's lead over the close down to a quarter point. The index gap is carried by about a third of its weight while the other third is red at the open, so the open-to-close is a tug of war with no base rate: p_up 0.54, none. No rating change on a mega cap appeared between 07:42 and 08:31; sniper stays null.

rotation.note: Bars to the 11-03 close (Alpaca daily). The month's rotation out of AI hardware into health care, staples, retail and banks gets an election overlay today: the same winners are bid pre-market and the AI-capex and Musk-linked names are sold. AMD's beat not lifting the group (SMH -0.4%, memory and INTC down on its PC comment) says the theme is still cooling; a chip gap-down day inside a cooling theme is not the gap-up fade of item 30, so no mechanical read.

zh.summary: 中期选举民主党拿下参众两院，期货夜里一度跌 1.4%，到早上反过来了：7:42 标普 ETF 盘前 +0.9%，纳指 ETF 只 +0.4%，小盘 +1.4%。钱的流向和这一个月一样再加一层选举：银行、医疗、必需消费、小盘被买，AI 基建和马斯克系被卖（特斯拉 -5.8%，GE Vernova -6.3%，甲骨文取消 70 亿腾讯协议 -4.2%，Palantir -3.8%）。AMD 财报超预期、盘后一度 +9.6%，到盘前只剩 +0.9%，芯片板块整体平到跌。8:15 ADP、8:30 贸易、10:00 ISM 服务业，今晚 ARM 财报。08:31 再看：ADP 新增 8.6 万好于预期的 6.9 万，标普 ETF 盘前 +0.9% 但纳指 ETF 只 +0.3%，半导体 ETF -1.3%，AMD 盘后的涨幅全吐光。上涨概率 54%，不够 60% 的线，今天不做 SPY。
